page_title: LYO 0-2 LIL | Lyon v Lille 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Samuel Umtiti (Lille) is on for Yusuf Yazici.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Golden chance! Remy Cabella (Lille) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
89' One of the players from Lyon times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
87' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
85' Angel Gomes (Lille) and Adam Ounas perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Ounas (Lille) is coming onto the pitch as Edon Zhegrova cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Remy Cabella (Lille) replaces Jonathan David.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sinaly Diomande will be replaced by Diego Moreira (Lyon).
77' Lyon keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
76' Jonathan David (Lille) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Anthony Lopes easily deals with the threat.
72' What was Paul Akouokou (Lyon) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
71' Ball possession – 47:53.
70' The cross into the penalty area from Mama Balde (Lyon) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
66' Yellow card. Mama Balde (Lyon) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tino Kadewere departs the field of play to be replaced by Dejan Lovren (Lyon).
64' Angel Gomes (Lille) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
61' Some patient build-up play from Lille as they look to unlock the defence.
59' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
58' Tino Kadewere (Lyon) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Lucas Chevalier is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
57' Mama Balde (Lyon) blows a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounced on a rebound but headed it just over the crossbar.
56' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
56' Jonathan David (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Eric Wattellier saw the whole situation.
53' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Angel Gomes (Lille) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
50' Jonathan David (Lille) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Anthony Lopes.
49' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

48' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Anthony Lopes sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top left corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Ivan Cavaleiro is replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
46' Fabio Grosso makes a switch. Mama Balde is coming on in place of Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) at the start of the second period.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) is replaced by Rayan Cherki.
46' A substitution has been made. Skelly Alvero is replaced by Paul Akouokou (Lyon).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' What a miss! The corner finds Henrique (Lyon) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
44' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) steps up to send the ball in.
43' An attempted cross from Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) is cleared. Lyon have a corner.
41' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
41' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Now Lille have a corner.
39' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
35' Referee Eric Wattellier points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Lille players.
34' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Lille can stand using VAR.
32' The expression of the referee Eric Wattellier is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Tiago Santos (Lille) is shown a yellow card.
32' 0 - 2 Tiago Santos (Lille) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
30' The goalkeeper dives to deny Yusuf Yazici (Lille), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Yusuf Yazici, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
27' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Tino Kadewere (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Lucas Chevalier easily catches the ball.
22' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

22' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
17' Lucas Chevalier (Lille) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
13' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is yellow-carded.
12' Tino Kadewere (Lyon) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
11' The ball is cleared after Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is penalised for a foul. Eric Wattellier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
9' The resulting corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) comes to nothing.
8' A snap shot by Edon Zhegrova (Lille) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes produces a good save to thwart him.
7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
5' A snap shot by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
2' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lille will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Eric Wattellier.
